verdict.rationale: incident.io documents more than 40 ready-made alert sources plus a custom HTTP source. It also names specific monitoring integrations such as Datadog, Honeycomb, New Relic and Grafana. Alerts are routed to escalation paths 'by team, service, or anything else', with team assignment per alert source, payload query expressions, and priority/working-hours rules on escalation paths. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring condition-based alert routes (most routing evidence is marketing-level), independent or hands-on corroboration.
